state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors frame the broad question as whether some variant of debate works as a component of an overall alignment strategy, pointing to the Buhl et al. (2025) safety case sketch, and hope future protocols combine prover-estimator debate with advantages of other scalable oversight methods. They highlight protocols that mitigate systematic errors in human input and the potential for debaters to hide information in subclaims, noting the safety case sketch has many more holes to fill.
title: Open: protocols robust to systematic human error and information hidden in subclaims
